Subject: Security & Deployment: Private VPC / SOC 2 / GDPR follow-up

Hi Jane / Acme Security team,

Thanks again for the call today — great to meet you all. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the deployment conversation: 

Recap (from our discussion):
- SOC 2: Redwood is in progress on SOC 2 Type II; target completion and report availability is 2028-11-15. We discussed interim evidence and controls we can share.
- GDPR: You need EU data residency for some of your workloads; we support region pinning for inference and can deploy in AWS eu-west-1.
- HIPAA: You mentioned PHI in some pipelines; we flagged BAA/contracting needs and technical isolation options (Private VPC, on-prem / air-gapped).
- Deployment modes: We covered Dedicated VPC with PrivateLink, and an on-prem air-gapped option for regulated workloads.

Next steps / action items:
1) I attached a short Redwood security overview and a sample VPC deployment diagram for your security team to review (redwood-security-overview.pdf, vpc-deployment-diagram.png).
2) Please share your completed SSQ or partial answers — we noted you might start with a subset. If you can attach what you have, we’ll review and return answers in 48 business hours.
3) We should schedule a technical deep dive with Marcus (runtime/architecture) and Neha (product + compliance integration) to walk the deployment options and confirm any network/IP allowlist and routing constraints. My Calendly link: https://calendly.com/marissa-co/tech-deep-dive
4) Internal ask for Redwood: confirm BAA readiness and estimated timeline/cost delta for on-prem/air-gapped deployment.

Proposed timing: Technical deep dive — Wed 6/28 or Thu 6/29 (PST). Let me know what works.

Thanks — I’ll start a shared doc in Drive for the SSQ and evidence exchange.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few quick notes from our side and I attached a partially completed SSQ for the items we captured during the call (acme-ssq-partial.xlsx).

Answers / clarifications:
- SOC 2: Thanks for the target date. We need interim artifacts (control mappings, status of in-scope controls) while the Type II report is in progress — that will be sufficient for our procurement bar for now.
- GDPR: Confirming we require EU residency for inference and embeddings storage for product X — eu-west-1 is ideal.
- HIPAA / PHI: We do process PHI in a limited subset of workflows, so BAA is required before production access. Could you confirm whether Redwood currently signs BAAs and the typical timeline?
- Network: For Dedicated VPC we prefer PrivateLink + no public ingress. For air-gapped/on-prem, we need a short write-up on supported architectures and what is required of our network/security team during deployment.

Open questions: 
1) Can you share your current encryption-at-rest key management options (KMS, customer-managed keys)?
2) For the on-prem option, can you confirm whether the deployment requires outbound connectivity for telemetry, and if so what endpoints/ports?

We’re flexible on the deep dive — Wed 6/28 11:00 PST would work for the security engineers.

Thanks,
Jane

Thanks Marissa — quick plan and what I can deliver before EOD Fri 6/30: 

1) Architecture options (short doc + diagram; I'll attach updated vpc-deployment-diagram.png):
   - Option A: Dedicated VPC (our recommended path for fastest time-to-production)
     * PrivateLink endpoints for inference, no public ingress to model endpoints.
     * Customer VPC peering or PrivateLink provisioning; support for IP allowlists and NAT-free design.
     * KMS: support for customer-managed CMKs in AWS KMS for encryption-at-rest.
     * Telemetry: minimal outbound to telemetry.redwood.ai for health/metrics; can be routed through customer proxy or blocked for air-gapped installs.
   - Option B: On-prem / air-gapped deployment (higher engineering + procurement effort)
     * Full offline bundle with orchestrator; no outbound required for inference if desired.
     * Requires pre-provisioned hardware and secure transport for initial image + model weights.
     * Offline key management options or HSM integration on-prem.
     * Quantization/latency notes: on-prem can match latency of dedicated pools if hardware parity; extra ops to manage model updates.

2) Interim SOC2 artifacts we can provide now (I'll ask Neha to confirm exact docs): control matrix, system boundaries, current control tests, and remedial actions map.

3) BAA: we do support BAAs — Neha / legal to confirm exact turnaround but typical is 2-4 weeks depending on redlines.

4) Action: I'll attach the diagram and a 2-page options doc to the shared Drive by EOD Fri. Also will prepare a short list of endpoints/ports used for telemetry so Acme can evaluate firewall requirements.

If you want me on the call Wed 6/28 11:00 PST to walk these, I’ll be there.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Staff Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
